parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the container cluster to query.
> You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~182997~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page when paging is used.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page when paging is used. Default value: 20.
